main_text.p: דוּמָה f. Silentium; Sepulchrum, sic dictum, quòd illic fit Silentium à celebrando Deo, Psal.115.17. & 94.17. Est & Nomen proprium regionis, Jesa.21.11.
דּוּמָס Silens, Jesa.47.5. לְאֶבֶן דּוּמָם Lapidi silenti, Hab.2. v.19. Convenit cum דֻּמָה & דָּמָם, quæ etiam vide.

דִּין Judicavit, Disceptavit, Judicium exercuit, Causam egit, Jus dixit: Præter. דָּן דִּין עָנִי Judicavit causam pauperis, Jer.22.16. Chald. Partic. דָּאנִין Causam cognoscentes, Esr.7.25. ubi Masorethæ notant legendum דִּינִין: quia א Scheva mobili affici non solet; simile in דור. At quum א habet Scheva compositum, manet: Vide קום. Niph.Partic. נָדוֹן Disceptans apud se, 2.Sam.19.9. Hiph. הָדִין Judicavit, &c. ut ante. In Infinitivo & Imper. communiter deficit ה characteristicum: Infinit. לָדִין Ad judicandum, pro לְהָדִין, Jesa.3.13. Imper. דִּין Judica, Job.35.14.
דַּיִן m. Judex, Psalm.68.6. 1.Sam.24.16. Chald. Plural. דַּיָנִין Causidici, causarum cognitores, Esr.7.25.
דִּין m. Judicium, Causa, Sententia judicata, Deut.17.8. Aff. וְדִינִי Et causam meam, Psal.9.5.
דּוֹן m. Idem: שָׁדוֹן Quod judicium est, Job.19.29. Quod ex jure justum & æquum est.
דִּין Chald. Idem, Dan.4.34. Emphat. דִּינָא, Dan.7. v.10. vel דִּינָרָא Esr.7.27.

מָדוֹן m. Contentio, ut Psal.80.7. אִישׁ מָדוֹן Vir contentionis, id est, contentiosus, Jer.15.10. Plurale est, אֵשֶׁת מְדָנִים Mulier contentionum, id est, contentiosa, Prov.27.15. & מְדָנִים Prov.18. v.18. Constr. מְדִינֵי אִשָּׁה Contentiones mulieris, Prov.19.13.
מִדְנִים m.p. Idem, Prov.6.19. Volunt ex priori forma esse contractum.
מְדִינָה f. Provincia, quasi Jurisdictio dicta, Esth.1.22.

page.notes: Hebrew headwords and forms were read from a small, slightly blurred scan; vowel points and some consonants are uncertain and have not been individually marked with [?]. The Hebrew in the entry for דּוּמָס and the vowel pointing of several forms are the least certain. The large initial דִּין at the start of the Judicavit entry is an enlarged letter and is joined to its word. The Latin "Iesa" and "Iob" are printed with J and are copied as printed.
